text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: That day, Mejiro Ardan invited me over because she had acquired some rare tea leaves, and I enjoyed a cup of black tea at the Mejiro estate.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
No. I am just delighted
that it suits your fancy.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for coming all this way.
Well then—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Ardan-san!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Trainer was with you as well.
Excuse me, I will come back another time.
choice_data_list: It's okay, did you need Aldan for something?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I'd love to hear your thoughts
on the outfit for the next droit.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Ligne Droite"... commonly known as Droit.
It's a dance party held at Tracen Academy
at the end of March.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The participating Umamusume were dressed up glamorously in dresses and suits,
enjoying the dance as if at high society ball.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"Ardan-san, have you already decided
what you will wear for the next soirée?"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, if that is the case...
I was planning to wear the one tailored previously."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Yes. It is something I planned to wear
whenever I felt the time was right.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Huh—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: ...What do you think?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
My!
It is truly wonderful after all!
choice_data_list: Yeah, it looks great on you!
Yeah, it suits you so well!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Ah, thank you very much...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
I was worried I had pushed too hard with the challenge...
so I'm relieved to hear that.
choice_data_list: So you went with a suit, huh
So you went with a suit, huh?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Following high-society customs, the Droit house often chose dresses or suits. Among them, I felt that quite a few girls preferred dresses.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Yes. I had it redesigned to match my dance partner... my date.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Ever since I saw Onee-sama's... my sister's droit,
I have been preparing the base.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Ms. Ramonu's droit... meaning?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
If I recall... they arrived at the venue without a partner,
danced exquisitely all on their own...
and captivated the entire room in an instant, or so the story goes.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
"At that moment, everyone was staring at my sister...
No, they had no choice but to stare."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
—A date with someone who can rewrite
those vivid memories with me might just appear...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: As I was thinking that... a cherry blossom petal gently fluttered down right before my eyes.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Ardan-san...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: ...And so, this outfit holds a great deal of sentimental value to me.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
So, I tailored an outfit where even
the finest details carry meaning.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"Come to think of it...
You share the same hairstyle as Ramonu, don't you?"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
That braided updo...
From behind, you look just like her.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Are you conscious of Ramonu-san after all...?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: "...Mainly, I just wanted to tie my hair up to match my outfit, but—"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
"In the back of my mind... I might have been
picturing my sister's back."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Ardan spoke gently... but behind
those words, I felt her unmistakable love
and devotion for her sister shining through.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: "However, how nostalgic. You used to match quite often in the past, didn't you?"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I still remember Ardan-san walking behind Ramonu-san,
wearing the exact same hair accessory.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
She looked so very happy...
It was so unusual that it left quite an impression on me.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Even as a child, I realized that Ardan-san,
who was like an older sister to the rest of us,
was also a "little sister" to someone else...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
"...Everything my sister wore and did
looked so dazzling to me."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Um, it might still look like... I'm just imitating others, but...
choice_data_list: That hairstyle would suit you really well too.
That hairstyle would look great on you, too

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Thank you very much.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: I feel like I've caught another surprising glimpse of her...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Of course.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: I was curious about that as well.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: The shape is a bit rigid, or how should I put it... it doesn't quite feel like Ardan-san's image.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Yes, that is precisely the image I intend to dispel.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
"Glass legs"... If you let them
sense that fragility, it ruins the spectacle.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
A dance that makes the viewer feel uneasy
can hardly be called elegant.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: I see...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Indeed, I can sense true strength
from Ardan-san as she is now.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Right?
Even intense dancing...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Just like this♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Heh...♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Fufu...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Ardan-san taught me so many things
back in the day.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
The dancing was a part of it, too, but...
as an instructor, she always carried herself with such gentle grace.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Yet in truth...
your dancing carries such passion,
it feels as though it could melt the snow itself.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Hey, what were the two of you talking about?
I'm curious...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, it is nothing at all.
I was simply reaffirming
Ardan-san's charm, that is all――
